description: Deletes one contact, named by id. Without purge the contact and its chats drop out of lists, counts and the Inbox, and Cosend keeps their messages until a purge; if the person writes again, they become a new contact with a new chat. With purge true the contact and what Cosend holds about them are erased for good (an owner’s action, for a data-protection request). The deletion stays inside Cosend, out of the contact’s view. Each delete needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that names the contact and returns a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it deletes.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

purge.description: true to erase the contact for good, as a data-protection erasure does (owners only); omit to take the contact and its chats out of lists and the Inbox, with its messages kept.

name: delete_contact
title: Delete a contact
